messages:
Alex: anyone else notice a TTFT regression on dedicated after yesterday's mixed-quant kernel rollout?
Priya: saw it in dashboards around 03:10 UTC. TPS steady but first-token latencies for long sessions (>4096) jumped ~2.7x.
Ben: confirmed with microbenching. Prefill path seems to pick an fp8_dequant fallback on some transformer blocks when KV hit-rate drops.
Lina: can you paste the profiler snippet? want to see kernel launch vs compute time.
Alex: quick trimmed trace from canary run: 
```
[perf-bench] model=t5x-mixq quant=int4_fp8_auto
prefill: p50=78ms p95=420ms p99=1.2s
decode: p50=12ms p95=40ms p99=90ms
kvcache-hit-rate=0.42
kernel-route: layer3->int4_fast, layer6->fp8_deq_slow, layer9->int4_fast
nvtx: kernel_launch_ms: layer6_fp8_deq=180ms
```
Priya: layer6 is our long-attention block. If fp8_deq is chosen during prefill it serializes dequant+matmul and blows up TTFT even though overall TPS looks fine.
Ben: suspect batching heuristics the adaptive micro-window expanded during prefill which increased working set and caused KV misses, triggering dequant path.
Maya: perf-bot fired in #eng-sre at 03:12: 
perf-bot: alert: metric=first_token_latency_p99 channel=prod-dedicated threshold=800ms current=1200ms
Lina: local repro command I used: 
```
./run_load --model t5x-mixq --quant-profile int4_fp8_mix --batcher micro --micro-window 64 --seq 8192 --mode prefill --clients 64 --concurrency 8
```
Alex: immediate experiments: force int4-only routing on prefill, shrink micro-window to 16, add KV heatmap logging to verify eviction pattern.
Priya: toggling kernel routing flag on canary now: ROUTE_PREFILL_KERNEL=prefer_int4 and kicking a small run.
Ben: opened RI-1137 with nvprof traces and canary logs, assigned to eng-runtime: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-1137
Maya: scheduling regression triage 10:00. Canary pause condition: p99_first_token > 1s.
Lina: quick A/B notes from my local runs: int4-only prefill p95 dropped 420ms -> 160ms; micro-window=16 reduced p99 by ~30%; decode p50 unchanged.
Alex: that points to kernel routing + KV eviction interaction. Action items: implement a cheap prefill fastpath preferring int4 for layers with large KV state; add KV-hit smoothing to batcher to avoid aggressive adaptive window growth on bursty long-ctx traffic.
Priya: I'll run evals to check for quality regressions if we force int4.
Ben: I'll own the kernel rollout toggle and revert plan. Lina/Maya, can you own KV heatmap instrumentation + perf harness reproducibility?
Maya: adding CI reproducer and will attach traces to RI-1137.
Alex: update the ticket with canary ids and perf-bot snapshots when available. :thumbsup:
